title: Waiting by the water
content: Many nights I've dreamed of walking from the mall, down a sandy hill patched with beachgrass, to the water. There I wait with hundreds, maybe thousands of others. There's no calamity, no crying. People are standing around with their families, some speaking quietly. There's a feeling of resolute anticipation. I'm not sure what exactly we're waiting for, but what I feel is that it is "the end". The end of what? In one dream, I watched the water rise from a different perspective, from a broken away dock, ripped from its moorings. In most of them, nothing happens, we just wait. Last night, during the dream, I became lucid and exclaimed loudly that I recognized this place and had been here before, doing this exact thing. Then I woke up. Anyone else dream about waiting by the water?
